pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.emptyHint: A pipeline watches a folder, runs OCR on what lands there, and writes the results somewhere else.
pipelines.needsFolder: Impressive OCR can only read and write inside authorized folders, and none are set yet. Add one before creating a pipeline.
pipelines.needsFolderTooltip: Authorize a folder in Settings before creating a pipeline.

folderBrowser.title: Choose a folder
folderBrowser.truncated: Only the first 1,000 folders are shown. Use the filter to narrow the list.

runtime.notInstalled: The OCR runtime is not installed yet.
runtime.confirmNote: The download runs for several minutes and can be cancelled while it is going. Nothing has been downloaded yet.
runtime.tightSpace: That drive may not have enough free space for the install and its temporary files.
runtime.planFailed: Could not work out what would be installed. Is the service still running?

errors.loadFailed: Could not load data from the service.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Please check the values and try again.

editor.name: Name
editor.inputFolderHint: Files dropped here are picked up automatically.
editor.outputFolderHint: Created on first write if it does not exist yet.
editor.mirror: Mirror the folder structure in the output
editor.watchModeHint: Network shares do not deliver reliable events — use polling for UNC or NFS paths.
editor.fastHint: Runs on CPU. Good for everyday documents.
editor.accurateHint: Needs a GPU. Best on complex tables and messy scans.
editor.accurateUnavailable: The Accurate profile needs a compatible GPU, which this machine does not have. Jobs will run on the CPU using the Fast profile.
editor.accurateNeedsVram: The Accurate profile needs a {required} GB card or larger; this GPU has {vram}. Jobs will run on the GPU using the Fast profile.
editor.dpiHint: Higher is slower and mostly helps with small print.
editor.textLayerHint: Reusing an existing text layer is far faster and usually more accurate than re-running OCR.
editor.textHybrid: Hybrid — OCR only the pages without text
editor.textSkip: Skip PDFs that already have text
editor.moveToOutput: Move it to the output folder
editor.moveToArchive: Move it to an archive folder
editor.quarantineHint: Files that failed for good are moved here so the input folder stays clean.
editor.optionsRecovered: Some settings could not be read and were reset to their defaults. Check them before saving.
editor.loadFailed: This pipeline could not be loaded.

detail.idle: Nothing is being processed right now.
detail.deleteBody: "{name}" and its job history will be removed. Files already written to the output folder are kept.

settings.allowlistHint: Impressive OCR can only read and write inside these folders. Nothing else on this computer is reachable.
settings.allowlistEmpty: No folders are authorized yet. Add at least one before creating a pipeline.
settings.authHint: Required before the app may be reached from the network.
settings.schemeHint: https is required to reach this instance over the network. A self-signed certificate is generated on first use; your browser will warn once.
settings.networkRequirements: Reaching this instance over the network requires authentication, a password, and https.
settings.cpuBudget: Share of the processor OCR may use
settings.cpuBudgetHint: Fewer threads means less memory as well as less CPU. Lower this if the machine becomes unresponsive while OCR runs.
settings.concurrencyHint: Each one holds its own copy of the OCR models in memory — roughly 2-4 GB. Raise it only if you have RAM to spare.

auth.unreachable: Cannot reach the Impressive OCR service.
auth.passwordHint: Protects this interface when it is reachable from the network. Not needed if you only ever open it on this machine.
auth.passwordSaved: Password saved. Everyone signed in elsewhere has been signed out.
auth.passwordRemoved: Password removed and authentication switched off.
auth.currentRequired: Enter your current password to change it.
auth.removeWarning: Changing or removing the password signs out every browser, including this one.

quick.subtitle: OCR a few files once, without setting up a watched folder.
quick.uploadHint: Uploaded files are deleted as soon as their job finishes.
quick.downloadNotice: Results will be available as a ZIP download when the run finishes.
quick.runtimeNeeded: The OCR runtime is not installed yet, so nothing can run.
quick.browseFailed: That folder could not be opened.
quick.rejectedFiles: Skipped, not a document Impressive OCR can read: {names}
quick.hiddenFiles: {count} other file(s) hidden — only readable documents are shown.
quick.downloadExpires: Available for 24 hours after the run finishes.
quick.strategyHint: Most PDFs from a scanner have no text layer. One that does is already digital.
quick.strategyHybrid: OCR only the pages without text (recommended)
quick.tableCost: Loads 5 extra models and uses noticeably more memory.

logs.subtitle: Everything the service has recorded. Useful when a document fails and the reason is not obvious.
logs.truncated: Showing the most recent part of the log; older entries are in the file on disk.
logs.loadFailed: The log could not be read.
logs.clearFailed: The log could not be cleared.
